lemma.note: Kaikki s.v. sæta, cause/bring about < *sētijaną. Source asks the cause of commotion or a broken bow; not sweetness. Root-level sitting family only.

lemma.note: Kaikki kvæði < *kwēþiją, related to kveða < *gʷet- say. Source composition of a poem; remove resin root collision, retain speech root only.

lemma.note: Kaikki œrr -> ǿrr < *wōrijaz, possibly *h₂weH-, not the h₂er homographs. Source mad-man simile. Reporter’s alternative *wōþ- is not adopted; uncertain deeper origin left unmapped.

lemma.note: Kaikki ber noun < *basją/*bazją, berry; source heather bearing berries. Separate noun from bera and bare homographs; no secure PIE replacement asserted.

lemma.note: Kaikki sjǫt < *setō, abode/seat; source dwelling of gods reddened with blood. Root-level *sed- is supported; reflexive *swé is not.
